text: Creatine? That's basically steroids! It'll wreck your kidneys and make you bald!
That's a lot of fear, for something your body already makes.
Creatine is stored in your muscles, and you get some from meat and fish. It's one of the most researched supplements in the world.
Topping it up helps you squeeze out a rep or two more, so you build more strength and muscle over time.
Take three to five grams of creatine monohydrate every day, any time. No loading needed. The early weight gain is water inside your muscle, not fat.
Verdict: worth it. If you have kidney problems, ask your doctor first. Save this.
